questions.q: Which section would you expect in nearly every serious model technical report?
options: A list of every individual employee's salary
Architecture and hyperparameters, training data description, compute, post-training methodology, evaluation, and limitations
The exact source code of the training framework, line by line
A guarantee that the model has zero failure modes
questions.explain: Serious technical reports cover architecture/hyperparameters, a data description, compute/infrastructure, post-training methodology, evaluation results, and known limitations.

questions.q: If a technical report does not disclose the exact training data composition, what is the appropriate way to interpret that omission?
options: Assume the data must have been exceptionally clean and high quality
Treat the undisclosed information as unknown, not as implicitly favorable
Assume the model was not actually trained on any real data
Assume the omission proves the report is fraudulent
questions.explain: Labs often withhold exact data composition for competitive or legal reasons, not necessarily dishonesty -- but the correct reading is that the information is unknown, not that it's safe to assume something favorable.

options: A benchmark dataset that contains malware
When evaluation data has leaked into or closely overlaps with training data, inflating scores through memorization rather than reasoning
A benchmark that only tests coding ability
When a model refuses to answer benchmark questions
questions.explain: If training data wasn't carefully deduplicated against benchmark text, a model's benchmark score may reflect memorization of the test set rather than genuine capability.

questions.q: What should you look for in a report's evaluation section to assess whether its benchmark scores are trustworthy?
options: A stated decontamination methodology describing how benchmark overlap was checked and removed
The total number of pages in the PDF
Whether the report uses a serif or sans-serif font
The number of co-authors listed
questions.explain: A documented decontamination methodology is a key signal that benchmark scores reflect genuine capability rather than memorized overlap between training and evaluation data.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the `model-index` block in a Hugging Face model card's YAML front-matter?
options: It stores the model's private API key
It makes benchmark claims machine-readable and comparable across models
It automatically retrains the model on a schedule
It encrypts the model weights
questions.explain: The model-index block structures benchmark results (task, dataset, metric, value) in a machine-readable way so they can be compared across models -- though it's only as trustworthy as the methodology behind the numbers.
